_doc: Worked example for ofr-paper-mdpi-review-web. Rebuild the 3 MDPI-template Response docx: python3 .claude/skills/ofr-paper-mdpi-review-web/scripts/build_response_docx.py --config <this file>. Paths are relative to this file's directory.
title: WaveletMask: Wavelet-Domain Mask-Guided Degradation Detection for Old Film Restoration
questions: Does the introduction provide sufficient background and include all relevant references?
Are the conclusions supported by the results?
Are all figures and tables clear and well-presented?

gen_responses: Thank you. We revised the Introduction and Related Work to strengthen the background and positioning of the proposed wavelet-domain detector; please see the detailed point-by-point responses below.

Thank you. We clarified the evaluation protocol and separated the strictly controlled same-protocol comparison from the broader literature context, and added statistical validation (please see Responses 1, 2, and 9).
Thank you. We added a Response Analysis subsection (Section 3.6) and detector diagnostic probes (Appendix C) that make the LHFM and GFM behavior explicit (please see Responses 4, 7, and 8).

Thank you. We substantially strengthened the results with multi-seed paired statistics (Appendix A), artifact-type and failure-mode breakdowns, and a clearer no-reference evaluation (please see Responses 1, 3, 5, 7, and 10).
Thank you. We made the conclusions more conservative and explicitly scoped to the evaluated protocol, and expanded the limitations (please see Responses 2 and 10).
Thank you. We consolidated the results to four main tables and seven figures, added diagnostic visualizations (Supplementary Figure S6), and clarified the captions.
1.english_rating: The English is fine and does not require any improvement.
1.english_response: We thank the reviewer for this positive assessment. The revised manuscript was nevertheless carefully proofread for clarity and consistency.
1.additional: We sincerely thank the reviewer for the constructive and rigorous evaluation, which has substantially improved the manuscript. A marked-up version with all changes highlighted has been uploaded together with the revised manuscript.
